When we announce a model deprecation, we notify customers who are actively using the model by email and document the deprecation on this page. Unless safety or compliance concerns require a faster timeline, we provide the following minimum notice periods before model retirement: Generally available models: At least 6 months. Specialized variants of generally available models: At least 3 months. If safety or compliance concerns require us to retire a model sooner, we will provide as much notice as reasonably possible.
